001: Have you already signed up for the welcome party of the course?
Yes, I signed up this morning. And you? Are you going to come?
Of course, I think it's a good opportunity to meet new people.
Great! We can go together if you want.
I'd love to. What time does it start?
It starts at seven in the main courtyard.
002: Do you know anything about the talent show that the university organizes?
I've heard that registrations close on Friday.
Then I have to make up my mind soon. Do you think I should enter?
I think so, you sing very well and it would be a shame not to try.
You're right, I'm going to sign up this afternoon.
I'm really glad! I'll cheer you on from the audience.
003: Do you feel like helping to set up the booth for the book fair?
Yes, of course. What exactly do we need to do?
Mostly organize the donated books and put up the posters.
Okay, I can go tomorrow morning if that works for you.
Perfect, let's meet at ten at the library.
004: Have you seen the schedule for the cultural week?
Not yet, what activities have they prepared?
There are theater workshops, a photography exhibition, and a talk about travel.
How interesting! Which one would you like to visit?
I'd like to go to the theater workshop, it has always caught my attention.
Well, we could sign up together, if you'd like.
005: Who's in charge of the decorations for the end-of-year gala?
I think the second-year group, but they need more volunteers.
I could help with the balloons and the garlands.
Awesome! I'll mention it to the coordinator this afternoon.
Thanks, that way I'll sign up directly.
You're welcome, any help is appreciated.
006: Are you going to take part in the charity run next month?
Yes, I signed up with some classmates.
And how much do you have to pay to participate?
The registration is five euros, and everything goes to an NGO.
I think it's a great initiative, I want to sign up too.
That's great! The more of us, the better.
007: Did you hear that they canceled yesterday's lecture?
Yes, what a shame, I was really looking forward to listening to it.
But they said they'll reschedule it for next month.
Oh good! Do you know if we'll have to book a spot again?
I don't think so, I guess the current reservations will still be valid.
I hope so, because it was really hard for me to get mine.
008: What did you think of the play that the students performed?
I liked it a lot, especially the lead actress's performance.
Me too, you could tell they had rehearsed a ton.
Definitely, the effort showed in every scene.
Would you sign up for a theater workshop for next semester?
Maybe, after seeing this I've gotten the urge to.
009: Do you need help organizing the end-of-year trip?
Yes, honestly, there are so many things to prepare.
I can take care of finding accommodation if you want.
That would help me so much, I don't have time for anything.
Don't worry, I'll get on it this very week.
Thank you so much, I don't know what I'd do without you.
010: Have you seen the photos they published of the music festival?
Yes, I saw them on the university's page.
There are some really good ones, especially the ones of the jazz band.
That's true, you can tell they had a great time on stage.
I hope next year they organize another one just as good.
I'm sure they will, every year they make it bigger.
